ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate how the $14M in fraudulently obtained funds was used and who benefited from the scheme.
questions: How was the $14M in fraudulently obtained funds used?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover additional individuals or organizations involved in the scheme and shed more light on how the fraud was perpetrated.
